summary: A one-screen site for a free pixel font: a full-viewport grid of random characters that slowly flicker (3% of cells re-roll every 500ms) behind a single bordered card holding the name, a two-line pitch, Download/GitHub buttons and an email sign-off. A fixed light/dark switch is the only other control.

instances.look: Cream page filled edge to edge with a monospaced grid of random pixel characters (letters, digits, punctuation) in near-black, with one small cream card centred on top carrying the name 'db-pixel.club'
instances.ux: Nothing to scroll; characters in the grid re-roll at random so the background shimmers; a fixed square sun/moon button top-right flips light/dark (persisted in localStorage, defaults to the system theme)
instances.learn: For a single-style display font, a field of the font's own random characters is both the texture and the character-set preview; let a few cells change at a time so it feels alive without distracting

reconstruction.layout: Full-viewport (100vw × 100vh) absolutely positioned grid: cell = min(vw, vh) × 0.05 (45px at 1440×900), pitch = cell × 1.2 (54px), cols = ceil(vw/pitch), rows = ceil(vh/pitch), each char a span at left = j·pitch + pitch/2, top = i·pitch (≈27 × 17 = 459 spans); centred card 448px wide (max-w-md; 280px on mobile), padding 32px, 1px solid border in the text colour, background = page colour so it masks the grid; theme switch fixed top 16px right 16px, 1px border, 12px padding, 18px feather icon
reconstruction.typography: Everything in db-pixel (single style). Grid chars 45px (5% of the shorter viewport side); card title 48px (text-5xl, 24px on mobile); pitch 18px with ~1.4 leading; button labels 16px; footer line 13px with underlined link
reconstruction.behaviour: setInterval every 500ms: each grid span has a 3% chance to swap to a random char from A–Z a–z 0–9 and !@#$%^&*()_+-[]{};:,.<>?; grid regenerates on resize (debounced); theme toggle sets html[data-theme] to swap --bg-color/--text-color (light #fffdf1 on #001000; dark #001000/#121212 background with light text), aria-checked mirrors it; buttons invert on hover (bg-current, text = bg colour)
reconstruction.content: No sample text: random characters; card copy is casual ('Pretty cool font right? And it's free for you to download and use and / or modify however you please. Have fun and tell your designer friends about it ;)')

instances.look: Two full-width outlined buttons stacked inside the hero card: '⤓ Download Font' and 'GitHub' with feather icons
instances.ux: Download Font fetches db-pixel.zip directly from the site; GitHub links to the repository; the licence is stated in plain words in the card ('use and / or modify however you please')
instances.learn: When the font is free, the pitch sentence can double as the licence summary and the download sits right under it

reconstruction.layout: Flex column, gap 12px, buttons full card width (~384px), ~40px tall (py-2), 1px border, centred icon + label; margin-bottom 24px
reconstruction.behaviour: Hover fills the button with the text colour and inverts label and icon

instances.look: Inside the same card, above and below the buttons: 'Created something using this font? Feel free to email it to: hello@daanblom.com' and a centred tiny '2026, daanblom.com' line
instances.ux: Email address is plain text; the designer's site is an underlined link
instances.learn: Ask users to send what they make: the sign-off becomes a call for showcase material

reconstruction.layout: Paragraph block above the buttons, then a 13px centred line 16px below them, all inside the 448px card
reconstruction.typography: 18px db-pixel for the request, 13px (10px mobile) for the year/credit line
reconstruction.content: Email request and year + designer domain
